## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Call out anything that changes
what appears on screen, and any decision that is Rishi's policy call.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Preview behavior checked; no production data or credentials used

## Data and rollout

State any migrations, environment changes, browser-data impact, and remaining checks.
Merging and production cutover require Rishi's explicit go-ahead.

## Review

`review-required` needs a trusted, complete Tracefield Software Review for the exact
head (see `.github/review/README.md`). `SHIP` is an absolute stop. Agents never
merge, approve or request changes.
